info.name: Kotak Neo Trading APIs
info.description:
REST + WebSocket collection mirroring the kotak-neo-python SDK (neo_api_client), kept in sync with the current docs/functions/*.md reference.

USAGE
1. Import Kotak-Neo-PROD.postman_environment.json and select it as the ACTIVE environment (top-right dropdown) -- this must be done before running anything, see note below.
2. Set these values in that environment (edit the CURRENT VALUE column, not just Initial value):
   - consumer_key   : token from Kotak Neo app -> Invest -> Trade API
   - mobile_number  : +91XXXXXXXXXX
   - ucc            : your UCC
   - totp           : current 6-digit code from your authenticator app
   - mpin           : your trading MPIN
3. Run 'Auth > 1. TOTP Login'  -> captures view_token + sid automatically.
4. Run 'Auth > 2. TOTP Validate' -> captures edit_token + edit_sid + base_url automatically.
5. All trading / data requests then work (they read the captured tokens).

Notes:
- Environment variables take precedence over collection variables in Postman. If an environment is active, its (blank) consumer_key/tokens win even if the collection variable of the same name has a value -- this is why step 1 above matters. The test scripts on TOTP Login / TOTP Validate / Place Order write captured tokens into BOTH pm.environment and pm.collectionVariables, so the flow works whether or not an environment is active.
- session_base_url is the login host (mis.kotaksecurities.com).
- base_url is the trading host returned by tradeApiValidate (auto-set in step 4).
- neo-fin-key is always 'neotradeapi'.
- Order form bodies are x-www-form-urlencoded under a single 'jData' field, exactly as the SDK sends them.
- logout() in the SDK (v2.2.0+) is a LOCAL-ONLY operation (clears cached tokens) and makes no HTTP request; there is intentionally no 'Logout' request in this collection.
- margin_required no longer sends brkName/brnchId (broker_name/branch_id) -- removed as non-mandatory fields, matching docs/functions/portfolio/margin_required.md.
- modify_order no longer sends dd (product) or fq (filled_quantity) -- removed in the current SDK, matching docs/functions/orders/modify_order.md.

request.description:
TOTP login (SDK: client.totp_login()). Captures view_token + sid into both the active environment and the collection variables, so TOTP Validate (MPIN) can run immediately after with no manual copy-paste.

Headers: Authorization (consumer_key, no Bearer prefix), neo-fin-key, Content-Type: application/json.

Completes 2FA with MPIN (SDK: client.totp_validate()). Captures edit_token, edit_sid, and base_url (trading host) into both the active environment and the collection variables.

Headers: Authorization, sid, Auth (view_token from step 1), neo-fin-key. No Content-Type or Accept header is sent by the SDK for this call -- omitted here to match.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.nOrdNo) { pm.environment.set('order_id', j.nOrdNo); pm.collectionVariables.set('order_id', j.nOrdNo); } } catch (e) {}

request.description: SDK: client.place_order(). jData keys: am(amo), dq(disclosed_quantity), es(exchange_segment), mp(market protection, always "0"), pc(product CNC/NRML/MIS/MTF), pr(price), pt(order_type L/MKT/SL/SL-M), qt(quantity), rt(validity DAY/IOC; mcx_fo=DAY only), tp(trigger_price), ts(trading_symbol), tt(transaction_type B/S), os(order source, always "NEOTRADEAPI").

SDK: client.modify_order(). no = order number to modify (auto-filled from Place Order). jData keys: mp(market protection, always "0"), dq(disclosed_quantity), vd(validity), pr(price), pt(order_type), am(amo), tp(trigger_price), qt(quantity), no(order_id), os(order source).

Note: product (dd) and filled_quantity (fq) are NOT sent -- removed from the current SDK's modify_order() as non-mandatory fields the backend doesn't require for a modify request.
SDK: client.cancel_order(). on = order number (auto-filled from Place Order), am = amo (YES/NO, default NO).
SDK: client.holdings(). accept: */* (not application/json) — matches the SDK's exact header.
SDK: client.limits(). Always requests all segments/exchanges/products (seg/exch/prod = "ALL").

SDK: client.margin_required(). jData keys: exSeg(exchange_segment), prc(price), prcTp(order_type), prod(product), qty(quantity), tok(instrument_token), trnsTp(transaction_type), trgPrc(trigger_price). Optional stop-loss/square-off fields (slAbsOrTks, slVal, sqrOffAbsOrTks, sqrOffVal, trailSL, tSLTks) are omitted here since they default to unset.

Note: brkName (broker_name) and brnchId (branch_id) are NOT sent -- removed as non-mandatory fields (the backend defaults them to "KOTAK"/"ONLINE" itself); see docs/functions/portfolio/margin_required.md.

SDK: client.scrip_master(). Returns CSV file URLs per segment. Download the CSV to search/parse scrips (the SDK's search_scrip does this with pandas, and caches the result for the rest of the calendar day). Does not require 2FA — only consumer_key.
SDK: client.quotes(). Does not require 2FA — only consumer_key. Multiple instruments are comma-separated exchange|token pairs in a single path segment; keep '|' and ',' literal (unescaped).

Order/position feed at wss://<base_url host>/realtime (SDK: client.create_order_feed()).

Immediately after connect, send the RAW (non-JSON) handshake string:
{type:cn,Authorization:<edit_token>,Sid:<edit_sid>,src:WEB}

Then order/position updates arrive as JSON text frames. Use the SDK (create_order_feed) for production. Postman can connect and send the raw frame but has no auto-reconnect/parsing.
